CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

   A. Only the volume

6. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

13. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.

15. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
